subject: Voucher allocation request: Events Collective community tour
messages:
From: Alex Stone <partnerships@eventscollective.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor vouchers for June/July community tour

Hi Rachel —

We run a series of regional community meetups and a short newsletter that goes to ~9k devs. For the upcoming June/July run we want to offer sponsor vouchers to help lower the barrier for trials for attendees and readers.

As a starter ask: would Redwood be able to provide 200 promo vouchers (single-use codes) that expire 90 days after redemption? We typically distribute ~120 at in-person meetups and 80 via the newsletter; we can segment the codes by channel.

A couple of quick details:
- Promo name: RW-DEVCOMM (or we can receive a CSV list of codes you generate)
- Expected redemption window: July 1 – Sep 30
- Use case: engineers who want to test embeddings + chat for integrations

If you can share terms (trial length / usage limit / attribution text) we can attach the codes to the event page and newsletter. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks —
Alex
Alex Stone
Head of Partnerships, Events Collective

Hi Marissa / Aditya —

Forwarding a voucher request from Events Collective (Alex). They want 200 single-use promo vouchers for community meetups + our developer newsletter. Recommend we approach as: 150 vouchers for meetups (may be handed out in packets) and 50 for newsletter redemption. Redemption window they suggest is Jul 1–Sep 30.

Questions:
- Marissa: is the standard promo-term (90-day trial / 50k token limit) OK for this channel?
- Aditya: any commercial concessions we should consider (co-marketing placement, logo on assets) in exchange for the full allocation?
- Michael: can finance handle issuing a small breakage accounting note if many codes go unused?

If we approve, I can generate a CSV and send codes + short attribution language to Alex.

Thanks,
Rachel

Rachel —

150/50 split sounds reasonable. Prefer we offer a 90-day extended trial with a modest token cap to prevent misuse (suggestion: 75k token cap per code). In past newsletter pushes we've seen ~20–30% redemption, so the split seems safe.

If Events Collective will add Redwood to the event page + include a short blurb in the newsletter (50–60 words) we can consider adding a small co-marketing package (logo + single slide at event). That would be standard.

Please attach draft promo terms (I mocked something quickly) — attaching so Aditya / finance can confirm.

Marissa Cole
Director, Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Fine to approve 150 codes for in-person distribution + 50 for newsletter (total 200).
